text: MOM: Off on an adventure? Be safe out there!
Come home whenever you need a rest.
PROF. ALDER: Creatures have Natures that raise one stat and lower another.
Hidden potential differs between each one too. No two are quite alike!
Tall grass hides wild creatures.
Weaken them first, then throw a Capture Orb. A sleeping one is twice as easy to catch!
Fire beats Grass, Grass beats Water, Water beats Fire.
And a creature gets a 1.5x boost when it uses a move of its own type!
Playing with a friend? Each of you brings 3 creatures and you fight side by side.
Moves like Surf and Rock Slide hit both foes in a double battle!
